text: Quick ToF floor-plane head chain fit now, applied through the same head-chain override the head-and-arm-calibration-fro epic writes; the shared parts move here so nothing is built twice, and head-and-arm runs right after.

Fit the head mount roll and pitch, the pan-axis height and the tilt zero from the ToF floor plane, robust to noise, with the degenerate parameters fixed, residuals reported and results over sigma limits refused.

A guided capture: the node commands a pan/tilt grid within the current range, waits for stillness and collects ToF clouds with the head joint states at the cloud stamp; only the head moves (least dramatic servos), robot not on blocks, flat floor.
Apply writes the head-chain override and head_state_publisher publishes the overridden chain, so ground_estimator, Nav2 and the web UI map see the floor at z 0.
A Head floor fit step on the web UI Calibrate page: Start sweep, progress, result with residuals and the fitted values vs current, Apply; a guided process is fine.

Runbook: every deploy through scripts/deploy-nodes.sh; after merge the orchestrator and the user clear the floor, run the sweep and apply; acceptance /ground/state plane height 0 +- 1 cm, plane_vs_base < 0.6 deg at home and two other pan/tilt poses, fewer than 10 obstacle points on the flat floor.

Gate Q1 (recommended answer, 2026-10-21): the sweep drives the head directly on /head/joint_commands like the web UI head tab; start refused while an RGB-D capture or compute runs; head restored on every exit
